newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China cement producer Conch plans HK listing.
newsitem.headline: China cement producer Conch plans HK listing.

text.p: Cement producer Anhui Conch Group Co Ltd plans to issue H shares before the end of this year, but the size of the initial public offering has not been fixed, a company spokesman said on Tuesday.

The company has named Jardine Fleming Securities as the global coordinator, the spokesman told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin. H shares are stock of mainland Chinese firms listed in Hong Kong.
Based in eastern China's Anhui province, Conch has received the approval of the Securities Commission of the State Council to proceed with the offer, he said.
Conch plans to use the proceeds to expand cement output and pay down debts, he said but declined to give details.
The company can produce five million tonnes of cementa year, the spokesman said.
It expects cement output to be 3.8 million tonnes for 1997, up from 2.67 million in 1996, he said.
About 80 percent of the company's cement is sold in southern China and the remaining 20 percent in Southeast Asia, he said.
